title: Kenyan Lamb Wrap
description: A flavorful Kenyan-inspired dish featuring lamb, spices, and fresh herbs, wrapped in a charred wrap.
instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. Grill the lamb shoulder for 4-5 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
3. Let the lamb rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
4. In a small bowl, mix together the Kenyan-spiced oil, salt, and black pepper.
5. Brush the charred wrap with the spiced oil.
6. Slice the red onion and green chili, and layer them on the wrap.
7. Add sliced lamb on top of the onion and chili.
8. Dollop the zesty cucumber raita on top of the lamb.
9. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
